answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the sparrow hash is checked against the signal checkpoint at intake, the echo audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Ten thousand fake identities would need 86 days and roughly 1 million dollars to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
